instruction: Fix `url_encode` in `codec/url.py` so reserved characters such as '/' are percent-encoded. It currently calls `quote` with the default `safe='/'`, which lets slashes pass through unencoded.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/codec/url.py b/codec/url.py
--- a/codec/url.py
+++ b/codec/url.py
@@ -5,7 +5,7 @@
 
 def url_encode(text: str) -> str:
     """Percent-encode ``text``, encoding spaces and reserved characters."""
-    return quote(text)
+    return quote(text, safe="")
 
 
 def url_decode(text: str) -> str:
